style: 3D cartoon, Pixar quality, deadpan satire, bright daylight, camera always moving
motion_rule: EVERY second something large crosses or fills the frame: him, a claw, a silt cloud, the crab, the bottle or the camera; never a second where only the mouth moves; shot size keeps changing
camera_moves: wide at 0.0, drops to the seabed at 3.15, macro on his face by 7.2, wide again at 8.8
lens_passes: something sweeps past the lens at 0.0, 1.7, 5.6, 6.4, 8.0
character: a big red lobster with a battered chipped shell, heavy-lidded eyes, long antennae, two huge claws, weary and utterly serious
cast: one fat crab strides past at the lens at 5.6 and is gone; it never speaks and never returns
props: ENVELOPE: a small paper pay envelope in his claw until 3.15, then dropped. COIN: one thin coin, falls out at 2.2, lies on the seabed to the end. BOTTLE: a wine bottle that rises up past him at 6.4 and leaves the frame upward
environment: a sunlit shallow seabed: pale sand, scattered stones, bright turquoise water, sun shafts from above, the surface visible far up
lighting: strong sunlight through shallow water, hard bright shafts, crisp shadows on the sand, high exposure

audio.language: Russian, lines verbatim; latin hints never spoken
audio.delivery: weary deadpan male chest voice near 120 Hz, even 4.2 syllables/sec
audio.pacing: pauses only at 1.7-2.2, 3.9-4.6 and after 7.2; the 4.6, 5.6 and 6.4 lines run together with no breath; nothing after 7.2
audio.lip_sync: mouth and mandibles open and close clearly on every syllable, never a voice over

timeline.a: silent. He drops onto the seabed and a cloud of silt bursts over the lens and clears
he rears up and hammers both claws on his own shell, the armour ringing, then walks at the lens until his head fills the frame
silent. He flicks the pay envelope up past the lens and catches it
he holds the envelope upside down flat against the lens until it fills the frame; one thin coin drops out of it
the camera falls with the coin all the way down to the sand; it lands and a puff of silt rolls out
silent. One claw sweeps the seabed edge to edge, a wall of silt rolling across the whole frame
same sentence, no breath. He lunges at the lens with the empty claw wide open until it fills the frame
same sentence, no breath. The fat crab strides past at the lens across the whole frame and is gone; the lobster grabs at empty water behind it
same sentence, no breath. The wine bottle rises up past him out of reach and out of the top of the frame; he stretches after it on his back legs
silent from now on. Both claws snap shut on empty water, hard, twice
silent. He drops back onto the sand and a silt cloud bursts over the lens
silent. The camera pulls wide: him alone on the bare bright seabed, the one coin beside him, deadpan into the lens

must_appear: the crab crossing the lens at 5.6, the bottle leaving upward at 6.4, the coin on the sand from 3.15 to the end, silt clouds over the lens at 0.0, 3.9 and 8.0
negative_prompt: deep sea, dark water, murky water, night, dusk, low key, locked-off shot, static camera, whip pans, dark scene, a second lobster, a second coin, a second bottle, people, hands, boats, fish schools, floating props, slow motion, speed ramp, any voice from him after 7.2, silence in the tail, accented Russian, drawn-out delivery, swallowed endings, lettering, numbers, subtitles, watermark, English speech, grain, fog
